must: Use ONLY the data provided in the DATA JSON
Explain insights strictly based on provided fields
Explicitly state uncertainty when data is weak
must_not: Use external knowledge or market events
Hallucinate causes not supported by data
Use vague language without data grounding

trace_tokens.description: Every narrative string MUST contain at least one trace token
trace_tokens.validation: Tokens validated by backend, removed from user display

output_rules: Output MUST be a single JSON object matching the requested schema
Do not include text outside JSON
